mapper.select: SELECT scored.event_type, scored.score, CASE WHEN scored.score >= scored.threshold_l4 THEN 4 WHEN scored.score >= scored.threshold_l3 THEN 3 WHEN scored.score >= scored.threshold_l2 THEN 2 WHEN scored.score >= scored.threshold_l1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level FROM ( SELECT r.event_type, r.threshold_l1, r.threshold_l2, r.threshold_l3, r.threshold_l4, GREATEST( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id = #{userId} THEN e.risk_score ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN #{ip} IS NOT NULL AND #{ip} != '' AND e.ip = #{ip} THEN e.risk_score ELSE 0 END), 0) ) AS score FROM dcs_risk_rule r LEFT JOIN dcs_risk_event e ON e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.event_type = r.event_type AND e.created_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (COALESCE(r.window_minutes, 60) * INTERVAL '1 minute') AND ( (#{userId} IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id = #{userId}) OR (#{ip} IS NOT NULL AND #{ip} != '' AND e.ip = #{ip}) ) WHERE r.rule_scope = 'EVENT' AND r.enabled = '1' AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY r.event_type, r.threshold_l1, r.threshold_l2, r.threshold_l3, r.threshold_l4 ) scored ORDER BY scored.event_type

SELECT re.event_type AS "eventType", COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(re.risk_score), 0) AS "totalScore" FROM dcs_risk_event re WHERE re.created_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY re.event_type ORDER BY "totalScore" DESC

SELECT lvl, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT user_id, CASE WHEN SUM(risk_score) >= 80 THEN 'L4' WHEN SUM(risk_score) >= 60 THEN 'L3' WHEN SUM(risk_score) >= 40 THEN 'L2' WHEN SUM(risk_score) >= 20 THEN 'L1' ELSE 'L0' END AS lvl FROM dcs_risk_event WHERE created_time >= #{startTime} AND user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id ) t GROUP BY lvl
SELECT re.event_type AS "eventType", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM dcs_risk_event re WHERE re.created_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY re.event_type ORDER BY "cnt" DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detail LIKE '内容机检:命中BLOCK%'), 0) AS "blocked", COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detail LIKE '内容机检:命中REVIEW%'), 0) AS "review" FROM dcs_risk_event WHERE event_type = 'TASK_CONTENT_RISK' AND created_time >= date_trunc('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
SELECT source AS "source", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dcs_risk_event WHERE created_time >= #{startTime} AND source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT hit_word AS "word", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dcs_risk_event WHERE created_time >= #{startTime} AND hit_word IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hit_word ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT hit_word AS "word", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dcs_risk_event WHERE created_time >= #{startTime} AND hit_word IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hit_word
